entries.format: decimal TCP port, 1-65535
entries.description: Local or self-hosted service listen port.
entries.failureBehavior: Defaults to 3001 for API and 3002 for Content; Vercel supplies its own port.

entries.format: bind hostname or IP
entries.description: Local or self-hosted service bind address.
entries.failureBehavior: Defaults to 0.0.0.0.

entries.format: PostgreSQL connection URL, with TLS required for hosted databases
entries.description: Core authoring and publication database connection.
entries.failureBehavior: Core routes and migration commands fail closed.

entries.format: same opaque high-entropy token on API and Content
entries.description: Service authentication for API to Content publication.
entries.failureBehavior: Publication is rejected with 401 or unavailable status.

entries.format: long random shared HMAC secret
entries.description: HMAC key shared by API and Realm revalidation handler.
entries.failureBehavior: Revalidation cannot be authenticated.

entries.format: PostgreSQL connection URL, with TLS required for hosted databases
entries.description: Better Auth identity, account, session and security database.
entries.failureBehavior: Auth readiness fails and database-backed requests cannot run.

entries.format: long random secret, unique to the Auth deployment
entries.description: Better Auth signing and encryption secret.
entries.failureBehavior: Auth readiness fails; the development fallback is not a production configuration.

entries.format: comma-separated exact origins, including scheme and no path
entries.description: Browser origins allowed by Better Auth.
entries.failureBehavior: Auth readiness fails and unlisted browser origins are rejected.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS S3-compatible endpoint URL
entries.description: Object storage endpoint for published Content objects.
entries.failureBehavior: Content readiness and reads return not ready.

entries.format: provider region identifier
entries.description: Object storage region passed to the S3 client.
entries.failureBehavior: Content storage cannot be constructed.

entries.format: boolean string: true/false (false selects virtual-hosted style)
entries.description: S3 addressing mode switch for the configured endpoint.
entries.failureBehavior: Defaults to path-style addressing.

entries.format: read-only object-storage access key ID
entries.description: Object storage credential for Content reads and publication verification.
entries.failureBehavior: Content storage is not ready.

entries.format: read-only object-storage secret access key
entries.description: Object storage secret paired with S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID.
entries.failureBehavior: Content storage is not ready.

entries.format: bucket name, without protocol or slash
entries.description: Private bucket containing immutable Content release objects.
entries.failureBehavior: Content readiness and reads return not ready.

entries.format: long random secret unique to Console
entries.description: Console opaque-session encryption and signing key.
entries.failureBehavior: Session creation and validation fail closed.

entries.format: OAuth client identifier issued by Auth
entries.description: Console OAuth client identifier.
entries.failureBehavior: Authorization and token exchange fail.

entries.format: OAuth client secret issued by Auth
entries.description: Console OAuth client credential used only by the BFF.
entries.failureBehavior: Token exchange fails; the value must never enter browser code.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS Upstash REST URL
entries.description: Distributed session and rate-limit store endpoint.
entries.failureBehavior: Console uses process-local session/rate-limit state.

entries.format: Upstash REST bearer token paired with the REST URL
entries.description: Distributed session and rate-limit store credential.
entries.failureBehavior: Console uses process-local session/rate-limit state.

entries.format: boolean string: 1/0 or true/false
entries.description: Allows trusted forwarded client headers for rate-limit keys.
entries.failureBehavior: Defaults off; Vercel's managed proxy is handled by platform context.

entries.format: feature flag: 1 enables, 0 disables
entries.description: Browser-visible switch for Vercel Analytics.
entries.failureBehavior: Analytics is not mounted unless the value is exactly 1.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS origin allowed in production CSP script-src
entries.description: Analytics script origin added to the Console CSP.
entries.failureBehavior: No extra script origin is added.

entries.format: absolute HTTPS origin allowed in production CSP connect-src
entries.description: Analytics connection origin added to the Console CSP.
entries.failureBehavior: No extra connection origin is added.
